integrity_note: Per-row hash pins unavailable this run: the runtime stopped persisting db tool output to agent tool-output dirs after ~18:29Z (verified by test queries), and hand-transcribing 466 (mid, md5) pairs was rejected as unreliable. Aggregate-pinned instead: per-page row counts, ts ranges, and exact body-byte sums (chars; sum of SQL length()), plus exact first/last-row (message_id, body_md5, body_len) anchors per page. A re-query of the same window with the same ORDER BY reproduces every value here exactly.
query: SELECT m.message_id, e.created_at, length(m.body) AS blen, md5(m.body) AS bmd5 FROM runtime.events e JOIN runtime.messages m ON m.event_seq = e.event_seq WHERE e.created_at >= '2026-09-13T15:46:00.595+00:00' AND e.created_at < '2026-09-13T18:30:00+00:00' AND e.role = 'system' AND e.event_kind = 'message' ORDER BY e.event_seq LIMIT 200 OFFSET {0,200,400}
